name: cs-five-whys
description: Finds the few contact reasons that drive most of your volume and asks why until each reaches a fixable process, producing a Pareto table of drivers, a 5 Whys chain per driver and a list of asks for product with owners and dates. Use for "run cs-five-whys", "5 whys", "root cause analysis for tickets", "ticket driver report", "top contact drivers", "why do customers keep contacting us", "voice of the customer report", "product never hears it", part of the AI for Customer Service Pack by 90n.
